annotations.title: Check a PDF for redactions that did not remove the text

description: Finds black boxes drawn over text in a PDF and reports where the text underneath can still be selected or copied, and redaction annotations that were never applied. Returns locations and counts, never the hidden text. Checks text only: it does not look at images, metadata or earlier revisions. Price: 0.01 USDC per PDF. MCP tool: `check_redactions`.
name: check_redactions
title: Check a PDF for redactions that did not remove the text
